title: Electronic Flight Bag — Installation of the Unit on the Ventilated Arm

ata.title: Flight Deck Information — Electronic Flight Bag Unit

abstract: Installation of the electronic flight bag unit on the ventilated arm, with the clearance checks against the windscreen and the sidestick full travel, and the switched supply functional check.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the electronic flight bag unit on the ventilated mounting arm, to check the clearances that the installation approval depends on, and to do the switched supply functional check.
sections.job_setup_note: The clearance checks are not optional. The arm holds the unit closer to the sidestick than the original and the full travel clearance must be measured with the gauge, not judged by eye. The switched supply removes display power on ground power with no crew logged in, which looks like a failure if the check is done without knowing it. Work is from the flight deck with the side console trim removed.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove electrical power and remove the side console trim on the side being worked. 2. Confirm that the ventilated arm is installed and that its retaining bolts are torqued. 3. Put the unit on the arm cradle and engage the retaining catch until it is felt to latch. 4. Connect the unit connector and the additional discrete at the connector assembly. 5. Route the unit harness with the service loop shown in the installation drawing and clamp it. CAUTION: DO NOT SHORTEN THE SERVICE LOOP. THE ARM SWINGS THROUGH ITS FULL TRAVEL AND A SHORT LOOP PULLS THE CONNECTOR. 6. Measure the clearance between the unit and the windscreen with the clearance gauge and confirm it is not less than the figure given. 7. Move the sidestick through its full travel in all directions and confirm no contact with the unit or the arm at any point. WARNING: DO NOT DECLARE THE INSTALLATION SERVICEABLE IF THE SIDESTICK TOUCHES THE UNIT AT ANY POINT OF ITS TRAVEL. 8. Swing the arm through its full travel and confirm that the harness is not strained and does not chafe. 9. Restore electrical power. 10. Do the flight bag functional test. 11. With the aircraft on ground power and no crew logged in, confirm that the display removes power, and that it restores on log-in. 12. Refit the side console trim.
sections.close_out: Confirm that the side console trim is secure and that the arm latches in its stowed position. Record the unit part number, the measured windscreen clearance and the sidestick clearance result in the aircraft maintenance record. Tell the flight crew that the display switches off on ground power when no crew member is logged in.

type_data.effectivity_note: Aircraft post MOD-147210 only. On earlier aircraft use the fixed arm procedure in the previous issue of this task.

safety_precautions: Remove electrical power before the console trim is removed.
Do not move the sidestick with a person in the seat during the clearance check.
